cookies.subtitle: Manage cookies used by requests
cookies.description: A global Cookie Jar with domain, path, expiry and persistence managed by Rust.
cookies.name: Name
cookies.session_hint: Leave empty for no fixed expiry. The persistence switch controls whether this cookie survives restarting the app.
cookies.persistence_hint: When enabled, this cookie is saved as plain text in the application data directory. Disabling removes its saved copy immediately and keeps it in memory only.
cookies.confirm_clear: Clear all cookies? This removes cookies from both memory and disk.
cookies.empty: No cookies. Add one or receive cookies from a response.
cookies.request_hint: Only selected cookies matching the domain, path, HTTPS and expiry rules are sent. Response Set-Cookie headers are collected globally in memory by default and are available during this request's redirects.
cookies.header_conflict: Use either a manual Cookie header or Cookie Jar selections to avoid duplicate or overridden cookies.
cookies.missing: {count} selected cookies are missing or expired.
cookies.not_matching: Does not match this URL and will not be sent.
